answer: Escrow with dispute slashing blocks sybil entry. A new identity locks 200 units for 12 epochs. Any peer may dispute it within 3 epochs. A 9-member jury rules within 2 epochs. A confirmed fake loses 80% of escrow. The challenger earns 25% of the slash. The fake is barred for 12 epochs. A dune of frozen deposits piles up behind every disputed identity. Each tide of new disputes sweeps the queue clean. An island of honest identities forms apart from fakes. Forging 1,000 identities locks 200,000 units. A 30% catch rate slashes 48,000 units. The attack loses money.
